commits_data.message:
epan: Add and use fvalue_new_pool

Add fvalue_new_pool(), which allocates an fvalue using a given wmem
pool. Use it during dissection instead of fvalue_new(), which lets us
avoid g_slice_new() and g_slice_free(). Get rid of CLEANUP_PUSH and
CLEANUP_POP in proto_tree_new_item() since they're no longer needed.

Assisted-by: Claude 4.8
